lifecycles._note: Coverage probe for 2 write-only certificatemanager ops that cannot reach 2xx read-only: POST /v1/certificatemanager/check-validation (validatecertificate) and POST /v1/certificatemanager (createcertificate/import). CONFIRMED LIVE 2026-06-20: validatecertificate returns 400 scp-security.certificate.pem-format-private-key-error for ALL key types (RSA PKCS#1 BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY, PKCS#8 BEGIN PRIVATE KEY, EC BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY) — this is a backend-side validation that rejects any private key regardless of format. The selfsign lifecycle (security-certificatemanager-selfsign in scenarios.json) covers the self-sign + read + delete path. The import lifecycle (security-certificatemanager-import in scenarios.json) is blocked until real CA-signed cert material is available. This fragment merely CALLS the two write ops with placeholder bodies as guarded optional steps (4xx expected, recorded as reached) so they appear in coverage when mutations are enabled. BODY FACTS (YYYYMMDD date format, confirmed 2026-06-20): selfsigncert requires cn, name, not_before_dt=YYYYMMDD, not_after_dt=YYYYMMDD, organization, recipients=[], region, tags=[], timezone='Asia/Seoul'. checknameduplication requires only {name}: returns 200 {result:false} (non-destructive read-style POST).

steps.name: check-validation
steps._note: CONFIRMED 2026-06-20: returns 400 scp-security.certificate.pem-format-private-key-error for ALL PEM private key formats. Backend validation rejects every key type. Endpoint IS reachable (not 403 entitlement). Category: backend-validation-400, not a product bug per se — requires a real CA-chain-signed cert+key pair.

steps.name: import
steps._note: CONFIRMED 2026-06-20: 5 required fields (cert_body, name, private_key, recipients, region) + cert_chain optional. One additional required field unknown beyond these 7. Also rejects all PEM key formats same as check-validation. Needs real CA-signed cert material.
